questions.question: Shams invested Rs. 4000 at 10% per annum compound interest. After n years, Shams received Rs. 1324 more, Find the value of n.
questions.solution:
**Given,**

Principal (P) = Rs. 4000

Rate of interest (R)= 10% per annum

No. of years = n

**FORMULA USED:**

Compound interest(C.I) = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ - P

**CALCULATION:**

⇒ C.I + P = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ 4000(1 + 10/100)ⁿ = 4000 + 1324

⇒ 4000 × (1.1)ⁿ = 5324

⇒ (1.1)ⁿ = 1.331

⇒ n = 3

questions.question: A force 20 N displaces an object through 2 m and does a work of 20 J. The angle between the force and displacement is:
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 4**__ i.e __**60°**__. 

__
 
• Work Done (W) is equal to the product of the force (F) and displacement (d).

• **So angle between the force and displacement is 60__**°

questions.question: The ages of A and B differ by 16 years. If 6 years ago, the elder one was 3 times as old as the younger one, find the present age of the younger between A and B?
questions.solution:
Lets consider A is older and B is younger.

A - B = 16

A = B + 16 -------(1)

According to Question

A - 6 = 3(B - 6)

A - 6 = 3B - 18

3B - A = 12

Putting value of A from equation (1)

3B - (B + 16) = 12

2B - 16 = 12

2B = 28

B = 14 years

As we considered B as younger, so age of younger is "14 years".

Hence, "14 years" is the correct answer.

questions.question: If the edge of a cube is increased by 4 cm, the volume will increase by 988 cm³. Then what is the original length of each edge of the cube?
questions.solution:
Let the original length of each edge of the cube be x cm.

When the edge of a cube is increased by 4 cm, the volume will increase by 988 cm³,

⇒ (x + 4)³ - x³ = 988

⇒ x³ + 12x² + 48x + 64 - x³ = 988

⇒ 12x² + 48x - 924 = 0

⇒ x² + 4x - 77 = 0

⇒ x² + 11x - 7x - 77 = 0

⇒ x(x + 11) - 7(x + 11) = 0

⇒ (x + 11)(x - 7) = 0

⇒ x = 7

∴ Original length of each edge of the cube = 7 cm

**Tip:** We can find the answer quickly by putting the value of x in the following expression from given options.

Let original length of each edge of the cube be x cm.

⇒ (x + 4)3 - x3 = 988

questions.question:
Consider the given question and decide which of the following statements is sufficient to answer the question.

What day is the 14th of a given month?

**Statements: **

1. The last day of the month is Sunday.

2. The fourth Saturday of the month is 25th.

options.text: Statement 2 alone is sufficient while statement 1 alone is insufficient.
Statement 1 alone is sufficient while statement 2 alone is insufficient.

questions.solution:
Statement 1: 'The last day of the month is Sunday.' 

We cannot conclude what day was on the 14th of a given month because we don’t know whether the month is of 30, 31 or 28/29 days. So, statement 1 alone is not sufficient to answer the question.

Statement 2: 'The fourth Saturday of the month is 25th.'

We can conclude what day was on the 14th of a given month. The third Saturday of the month will be on the 18th. So, on 14th , the day will be 'Tuesday'.

Hence, statement 2 alone is sufficient while 1 alone is insufficient to answer the question.

questions.question: If a current of 1.5 A is maintained in a resistor of 10 Ohm, then the energy dissipated in the resistor in 1 minute will be:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1350 J**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Given: Current (I) = 1.5 A, Resistance (R) = 10 Ω, Time (t) = 1 minute = 60 seconds.
 
• Formula for energy dissipated: **H = I²Rt**, where H is heat energy in joules (J).
 
• Substituting: H = (1.5)² × 10 × 60 = 2.25 × 10 × 60 = **1350 J**.
 
• Since 1 joule/second = 1 watt, total energy dissipated in 1 minute is **1350 J = 1350 W·s**.
 
• Hence, energy dissipated is **1350 joules**, which matches option 1 numerically (not unit-wise, see clarification below).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Power (P)**

 
 
• P = I²R is the instantaneous power dissipated in a resistor.
 
• Here, P = (1.5)² × 10 = 22.5 W (this is rate, not total energy).
 
 
 
• **Energy (E) vs Power (P)**
 
 
• Energy = Power × Time.
 
• Power is the rate at which energy is used; energy is the total work done or heat dissipated.
 
 
 
• **Joule's Law of Heating:**
 
 
• Heat produced in resistor is proportional to square of current, resistance, and time (H = I²Rt).
 
 
 
• **Unit Conversions:**
 
 
• 1 J = 1 W·s; 1 kWh = 3.6 × 10⁶ J.
 
• In this question, energy is asked, so answer should be in joules, not watts.
 
 
 
• **Correct Unit Clarification:**
 
 
• The numeric value 1350 is correct for energy in joules, but **W (watt)** is a unit of power, not energy.
 
• The most precise answer should be **1350 J (Joules)**,

questions.question: If x² + ax + b, when divided by x - 5, leaves a remainder of 34 and x² + bx + a, when divided by x - 5, leaves a remainder of 52, then a + b = ?
questions.solution:
x² + ax + b, when divided by x - 5, leaves a remainder of 34,

⇒ 5² + 5a + b = 34

⇒ 5a + b = 9 ----(1)

Again,

x² + bx + a, when divided by x - 5, leaves a remainder of 52

⇒ 5² + 5b + a = 52

⇒ 5b + a = 27 ----(2)

From (1) + (2) we get,

⇒ 6a + 6b = 36

⇒ a + b = 6

questions.question: The ratio of the number of marbles that Joyee and Minati had was 5 : 6 while the ratio of the number of marbles that Jacob and Minati had was 5 : 9. What is the ratio of the number of marbles that Joyee and Jacob had?
questions.solution:
Ratio of the number of marbles that Joyee and Minati had = 5 : 6, while the ratio of the number of marbles that Jacob and Minati had = 5 : 9

⇒ Ratio of marbles of Joyee and Minati = 5 ∶ 6 = (5 × 3) ∶ (6 × 3) = 15 ∶ 18

⇒ Ratio of marbles of Jacob and Minati = 5 ∶ 9 = (5 × 2) ∶ (9 × 2) = 10 ∶ 18

∴ Ratio of marbles Joyee and Jacob = 15 ∶ 10 = 3 ∶ 2

questions.question:
Consider the given statement to be true and decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement: **

All work and no play makes jack a dull boy.

**Conclusions: **

1: To work is important.

2: One has to compromise work for play.
questions.solution:
Given: 

Statement:

All work and no play makes jack a dull boy.

Conclusions:

1: To work is important - Does not Follows (Because, The statement emphasizes the negative outcome of exclusively focusing on work without incorporating leisure, but it doesn't directly imply the importance of work itself).

2: One has to compromise work for play - Does not Follows (Because, The statement does not explicitly state a need to compromise work for play, but rather highlights the negative consequence of the absence of play alongside work).

So, **Neither conclusion 1 nor 2 follows**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question: 0.02overline {45} written as a vulgar fraction in its simplest from is:
A train crossed a 120 m long platform in 12 seconds and 165 m long platform in 15 seconds. The speed of the train was:
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

Let the speed of the train be ‘x’ m/s and the length of the train be ‘y’ m

A train crossed a 120 m long platform in 12 seconds,

⇒ 12 × (x) = 120 + y ----(1)

A train crossed a 165 m long platform in 15 seconds,

⇒ 15 × (x) = 165 + y ----(2)

Equation (2) - Equation (1) we get,

⇒ 3x = 45

⇒ x = 15 m/s = 15 × (18/5) km/h = 54 km/h

**∴ The speed of the train is 54 km/h.**

questions.solution:

• The number of periods corresponds to the number of shells in the atoms of the element it contains.
 
• As one goes down a group in the periodic table, the number of shells in the atoms of the elements increases.
 
• All elements have the same number of shells.
 
• So, if an element is in the third period, it has 3 shells.

questions.question: The hardest natural substance is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Diamond**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The hardest natural substance is Diamond.
 
• Diamonds are made from carbon that has been under high pressure and heat found in the depths of the Earth.
 
• The heat and pressure cause the diamond molecules to change so that they bond together.
 
• The molecules cannot move and form a rigid bond, which makes the diamond-hard.
 
• Copper, iron, and graphite are not as hard as diamond and can melt easily in comparison to the diamond.
